name: the wait binds every observed wake, not a slice
comment: Reverting to the slice drops a second settled wake at the wait; the control must lose the named disagreement error.

name: an unreported produced wake freezes as a visible ungraded row
comment: The decisive caller clause: without the freeze, a produced-but-unreported wake disappears from the report rows — the review's extra-wake blocker. (The produced/report-ids binding is a proven no-op once these rows exist; the freeze is what binds the denominator.)

name: the census records its own population
comment: Dropping the census record must be caught by the named assertion in _census_record, not a bare IndexError.
